title: One call-transport contract: the shell branches on capability, never provider
acceptance: ElevenLabs mic mute: elevenLabsCallTransport(fakeConv).setMicMuted(true) calls fakeConv.setMuted(true) exactly once and returns true; a fakeConv whose setMuted throws returns false and does not throw (today this try/catch lives inline in VoiceInterview.tsx:611-616).
ElevenLabs output mute: setOutputMuted(true) calls fakeConv.setVolume({ volume: 0 }); setOutputMuted(false) calls setVolume({ volume: 1 }) (today VoiceInterview.tsx:629-634).

ElevenLabs presence levels (the dead orb): with fakeConv.getInputVolume = () => 0.4 and getOutputVolume = () => 1.7, transport.sampleLevels(box) writes box.current = { input: 0.4, output: 1 } (clamped); NaN from either getter writes 0. Today nothing writes levelsRef on an ElevenLabs call - only transport/openai.ts:330 and :372 do - so InterviewPresence's halo reads { input: 0, output: 0 } for the whole call.

OpenAI mic/output mute: openAiCallTransport(fakeRefs).setMicMuted(true) sets enabled=false on every fake audio track of refs.mic; setOutputMuted(true) sets refs.audio.current.muted = true; both return false (no throw) when the ref is null.

Declared end capability, not identity: elevenLabsCallTransport(...).capabilities.finalizeOn === 'disconnect' with closeGraceMs 3000; openAiCallTransport(...).capabilities.finalizeOn === 'immediate' with pendingTurnGraceMs 3000; a pure planEnd(capabilities, { pendingCandidate: true, channelOpen: true }) returns { stopCaptureThenWaitMs: 3000 } for the OpenAI shape and { endSessionThenWaitMs: 3000 } for the ElevenLabs shape - the two branches VoiceInterview.tsx:516-524 and :1094-1111 decide today.

One contract suite, three transports: the same shared assertions (mute idempotent, teardown idempotent - calling end() twice sends one endSession/close, sampleLevels never throws, injectDirective returns a boolean) pass for the ElevenLabs adapter, the OpenAI adapter and a third in-test fake transport that names no provider.

Engine names leave the surface: a source-level check over app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx finds 0 occurrences of '=== "elevenlabs"' and '=== "openai"' (today 7: lines 423, 518, 611, 629, 705 as isActiveProvider, 802, 1094, and the ternary at 1131).
premise: app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:423 injectDirective branches providerRef.current === "elevenlabs" to pick sendElevenLabsDirective vs sendDirective.
app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:516-524 the closing-answer grace is gated on providerRef.current === "openai" (finalize).
app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:611-619 toggleMute branches on provider: conversation.setMuted vs micRef track.enabled.
app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:629-637 toggleAudioMuted branches on provider: conversation.setVolume vs audioRef.muted.
app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:802 and :1094-1111 teardown/end branch on provider (endSession + EL_DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS fallback vs immediate finalize).

app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:318 levelsRef is the box InterviewPresence reads (InterviewPresence.tsx:73); its only writers are app/_components/voice/transport/openai.ts:330 (output) and :372 (input). app/_components/voice/transport/elevenlabs.ts never writes it, though the installed SDK exposes getInputVolume/getOutputVolume (node_modules/@elevenlabs/react/dist/conversation/useConversation.d.ts:43-44, @elevenlabs/react 1.15.2).
app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:259-262 micStream is 'OpenAI only - the ElevenLabs SDK owns its own', another per-provider asymmetry the shell carries by comment.
app/_lib/voice/types.ts:8 VoiceProviderId is a closed two-member union; app/_lib/voice/types.ts:29 VOICE_PROVIDER_ORDER is the registry the picker enumerates.
rollback: Additive seam: call-transport.ts is new, the two transport files gain an adapter factory beside their existing exports, and VoiceInterview.tsx swaps seven inline branches for calls on one transport object. Reverting the commit series restores the inline branches byte for byte; no stored data, route or wire shape changes.
runner_up: Extract the call lifecycle (phase, endedAs, finalized/reachedLive/errored/endInFlight refs, the 30-field per-attempt reset in start() at VoiceInterview.tsx:873-926, and the end-signal object built twice at :670-679 and :820-836) into a pure call-attempt reducer.
body:
## Summary
VoiceInterview.tsx (1449 lines) branches on the provider's name in seven places: directive injection, the closing-answer grace, mic mute, output mute, unmount teardown, the end handshake and the speaking flag. Move each one behind a single CallTransport contract with declared capabilities. The shell then asks what the transport can do and never which transport it is. The branch-by-name has already produced one visible gap: the presence orb's level meter is fed only by the OpenAI transport, so on an ElevenLabs call the orb stays flat for the whole interview.

## Description
The registry technique engine-abstraction says it directly: "The tell that the abstraction has failed is an engine's name appearing in surface code." Here the two transports share one shell, but the shell still holds knowledge that belongs to each engine. OpenAI finalizes immediately after a 3 s pending-transcription grace. ElevenLabs must endSession and wait for onDisconnect. They mute the mic differently, mute the output differently and report speaking differently. The cost of this has two parts. (1) Parity drifts without anyone seeing it: levelsRef, the box InterviewPresence animates from, is written only in transport/openai.ts:330 and :372, although the installed ElevenLabs SDK exposes getInputVolume and getOutputVolume. (2) A third engine, such as a self-hosted realtime transport alongside packages/voice-tts, means finding and editing seven branches in a 1449-line component that no node:test can import.

The move: a new transport/call-transport.ts defines `CallTransport { capabilities; setMicMuted; setOutputMuted; injectDirective; isSpeaking; sampleLevels(box); end(); }`. It also holds two node-importable adapter factories: `elevenLabsCallTransport(conv)`, which takes the SDK object structurally so the test never loads @elevenlabs/react and imports elevenlabs.ts only as a type, and `openAiCallTransport(refs, cues)` over the existing OaiRefs and send functions. A pure `planEnd(capabilities, state)` replaces the two provider branches in finalize() and end(). VoiceInterview.tsx builds the active transport once per attempt from `connect.provider`, which already carries the failover authority (:979-982). It calls sampleLevels on the orb's frame for transports that do not push levels themselves. Starting a session keeps its own provider-specific entry points: startOpenAiCall and startElevenLabsSession differ in their inputs by design. The contract covers the live call, not the handshake.

Out of scope: provider selection, /connect, the director loop and the transcript persistence hook. Not in any r07 write set. The r07 voice-interview-api cards write only server files under app/api/interview and app/_lib/voice.

## Flow
1. Write call-transport.test.ts first: the seven acceptance cases against fake conversation and ref objects, so all of them are red.
2. Add call-transport.ts: the interface, capabilities, planEnd, and the two adapters that wrap the existing transport functions without changing them.
3. In VoiceInterview.tsx, hold `transportRef` and set it where providerRef is pinned. Replace the branches at :423, :516-524, :611-619, :629-637, :802, :1094-1111 and :1131 with transport calls.
4. The ElevenLabs adapter's sampleLevels feeds levelsRef, driven by a requestAnimationFrame loop owned by the adapter and cancelled in end(), which mirrors the OpenAI meters' raf refs.
5. Doc: add a paragraph on the transport contract and the capability list to docs/features/interviews/README.md.

## Expected impact
The orb animates on ElevenLabs calls, which is a candidate-visible parity fix. Adding a third live transport becomes one adapter plus the shared contract suite instead of seven edits in an untestable component. The mute and end semantics, where a mis-branch silently drops a closing answer or leaves a hot mic, move into node:test coverage for the first time. VoiceInterview.tsx shrinks by an estimated 60-90 lines.

## Evaluation
Claim: every provider-specific decision in the live call shell goes through one tested CallTransport contract, and the ElevenLabs presence meter is live.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (call-transport.ts does not exist, and grep finds 7 provider-name comparisons in VoiceInterview.tsx).
After: 7 of 7.
Method: node:test over app/_components/voice/transport/call-transport.test.ts plus the source-level grep case, under npm run test:unit. tsc, lint, lint:ts-ratchet and test:perf also run on the combined tree. No perf-budget exposure: VoiceInterview is reached only through VoiceInterviewClient's lazy import and the interview tab's dynamic() in app/features/shell/WorkspaceTabChunks.tsx:47, never from app/page.tsx's static graph.
Result: pending build.
Gate: architecture.
evidence:
grep -n 'providerRef.current\|=== "elevenlabs"\|=== "openai"' app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx -> 423 (=== "elevenlabs"), 518 (=== "openai"), 611, 629, 705 (isActiveProvider), 802, 1094, plus 1131 `liveProvider === "elevenlabs" ? conversation.isSpeaking : oaiSpeaking`.
grep -n 'levels.current' app/_components/voice/transport/openai.ts -> 136 (reset), 330 `levels.current = { ...levels.current, output: normalizeLevel(rms) }`, 372 `levels.current = { ...levels.current, input: ... }`; grep 'levels' app/_components/voice/transport/elevenlabs.ts -> no match.
node_modules/@elevenlabs/react/dist/conversation/useConversation.d.ts:43-44 `getInputVolume: () => number; getOutputVolume: () => number;` (package version 1.15.2).
InterviewPresence.tsx:73 `const raw = meter === "input" ? levels.current.input : levels.current.output;`.
wc -l app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx -> 1449.

title: A dropped call resumes itself: save the record first, then a cancellable redial
acceptance: Directed drop, record saved: reconnectPlan({ directed: true, ending: 'drop', finalStatus: 'failed', save: 'saved', autoUsed: 0, online: true, cancelled: false }) -> { kind: 'countdown', seconds: 5 }.

Directed drop, record NOT saved: the same input with save: 'failed' -> { kind: 'save_first' }; once the retried save lands (save: 'saved') the next evaluation -> { kind: 'countdown', seconds: 5 }. A redial never goes out while the session can still be in_progress server-side.

Start never dials over its own unsaved session: startPrecondition({ prior: { sessionId: 's1', save: 'failed' } }) -> { kind: 'retry_save', sessionId: 's1' }, and prior null or save 'saved' -> { kind: 'dial' }. Today start() clears saveFailed (VoiceInterview.tsx:874) and nulls sessionIdRef (:925) before POST /connect, which then answers 409 INTERVIEW_ALREADY_LIVE ('already running in another window') to the candidate's own tab for up to 30 minutes.
Refused save means stop: save: 'refused' (the 409 discardedTurns case, where another window's call on this link already finished) -> { kind: 'none' }. No redial and no Start re-offer is implied.

Undirected or decided endings do not auto-dial: directed: false with a failed drop -> { kind: 'manual' } (a restart with no agenda to resume must be the candidate's click); ending 'candidate_end' or 'director_end' -> { kind: 'none' }; finalStatus 'completed' -> { kind: 'none' }.

Budget and connectivity: autoUsed >= 2 -> { kind: 'manual', reason: 'budget' } (2 auto redials stay inside the 6-per-10-minute /connect token budget, leaving 3 manual clicks after the first start); online: false -> { kind: 'wait_online' }; cancelled: true -> { kind: 'manual', reason: 'cancelled' }.

Persistence exposes a tri-state, not a boolean: useTranscriptPersistence's pure helper saveStateOf({ saved, discardedTurns, inFlight }) maps to 'pending' | 'saved' | 'failed' | 'refused' ({ saved: false, discardedTurns: 3 } -> 'refused'; { saved: false, discardedTurns: 0 } -> 'failed'), the one input reconnectPlan reads.
premise: app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:857-870 handleOaiDrop finalizes the directed drop and sets errConnectionLost; recovery is entirely manual through the Start button labelled startAgain (:1300).
messages/en.json:2446 errConnectionLost = "The connection dropped. Press Start to reconnect and carry on from where you left off." This promises something the next point breaks.

app/_components/voice/VoiceInterview.tsx:874 start() calls setSaveFailed(false), and :925-926 null sessionIdRef/sessionTokenRef before POST /api/interview/connect (:943). A prior session whose /complete never landed (useTranscriptPersistence.ts:81-145 gives up after 3 attempts) stays unsaved, and the online/visibility re-drive (useTranscriptPersistence.ts:221-233) is disarmed because saveFailed is now false. The sessionStorage stash is replayed only on the NEXT MOUNT (useTranscriptPersistence.ts:169).

app/api/interview/connect/route.ts:158-163 refuses an in_progress session touched within LIVE_INTERVIEW_RECENCY_MIN (app/_lib/db/interviews.ts:472 = 30, predicate :482-493) with INTERVIEW_ALREADY_LIVE + retryAfterMin. Its own comment (:156-161) assumes 'every teardown path POSTs /complete', which is exactly the step that fails when the drop was the network.
messages/en.json:1829 INTERVIEW_ALREADY_LIVE = "This interview is already running in another window...". After a failed save, the candidate's own single tab is told this.

app/_lib/voice/finalize-status.ts interviewFinalStatus: a directed call that drops before closingBegun finalizes 'failed' on purpose so the reconnect RESUMES (same agenda, covered blocks). The resume path already exists (connect/route.ts:286-291 buildResumeContext; VoiceInterview.tsx:998-1002 seeds priorTurns; resume.continuing copy at messages/en.json:2538). Only the redial is missing.
app/api/interview/connect/route.ts:193-211 per-token connect budget: 6 per 10 min for paid providers ('one start + five reconnects ... retried manually, one click per attempt').
app/_components/voice/useTranscriptPersistence.ts:107-126 a 409 with discardedTurns is a REFUSAL (another window won); retrying can never help.
rollback: The redial is driven entirely by the new pure reconnect-plan.ts and one effect in VoiceInterview.tsx. Reverting the series restores the manual Start-only recovery. The persistence hook's new saveState is additive over its existing saveFailed/discardedTurns. No route, schema or stored shape changes. The four catalog additions revert with the commit (i18n:check stays balanced because all four land and leave together).
runner_up: Closing transcript review before an irreversible complete (the open leftover-develop-2026-09-17 item, gate direction). Traded away because r07's voice-interview-api card rewrites what /complete stores (the director ledger becomes the record), which moves that card's central premise.
body:
## Summary
When a directed interview drops, the product already knows how to resume it: same agenda, covered blocks, earlier turns seeded back, the interviewer briefed not to start over. But the candidate has to find the Start button again. If the drop also took down the /complete save, which is common because the drop usually was the network, that button walks them into 409 INTERVIEW_ALREADY_LIVE: 'already running in another window', with a 30-minute wait, in their only tab. Make the recovery act on its own. Save the record first, then redial after a 5-second countdown the candidate can cancel, at most twice, inside the existing /connect budget.

## Description
The candidate-portal user is the one person the product must not block (recruiting: degrade-never-block-a-candidate), and resume-affordances asks 'what may restore without asking'. A redial into a resumable attempt of an interview the candidate already consented to, cancellable, is that case. A restart of an undirected call is not, and stays manual.

The defect under the leap: start() clears saveFailed and nulls the previous session ids (VoiceInterview.tsx:874, :925-926) before POSTing /connect. /connect refuses any in_progress row touched in the last 30 minutes (connect/route.ts:158-163), and a session whose /complete never landed is still in_progress. The stash that holds the lost save is replayed only on the next mount (useTranscriptPersistence.ts:169), and the online re-drive is disarmed the moment saveFailed goes false. So errConnectionLost's 'Press Start to reconnect' is true only when the save happened to succeed.

The design: a pure reconnect-plan.ts computes `reconnectPlan(state)` over { directed, ending, finalStatus, save, autoUsed, online, cancelled } and `startPrecondition({ prior })`. The persistence hook exports a pure `saveStateOf` and a tri-state saveState ('pending' | 'saved' | 'failed' | 'refused') alongside its existing fields. VoiceInterview.tsx runs one effect on the plan. save_first re-drives retrySave for the PRIOR session. countdown arms a timer in the call's timer registry and calls start(). wait_online listens for 'online'. manual and none leave today's controls. The Start button calls startPrecondition first, so a manual click also settles the prior session before dialling. A small ReconnectNotice.tsx renders the countdown ('Reconnecting in 5 s', with Cancel and Reconnect now), the 'saving your answers first' state, and the budget-exhausted line. It is composed from recipes, token colours only, and verified in both themes. New copy: about 6 keys under interview.voice.reconnect.*, in all four catalogs and without em dashes (docs/i18n/contract.md §5). No new error codes.

No route changes. /connect and /complete are consumed as they are, so app/_lib/auth/public-routes.ts, api-reference.md and the rate-limit contract test are untouched. The r07 voice-interview-api transcript-of-record card changes what /complete STORES, not the in_progress to failed transition this card waits on, so it does not collide. Both write docs/features/interviews/README.md, the coupled doc. This card and slot A both edit VoiceInterview.tsx, so they belong in different waves (A first).

## Flow
1. Write reconnect-plan.test.ts with the 7 acceptance cases (all red).
2. Add reconnect-plan.ts (pure) and saveStateOf plus saveState in useTranscriptPersistence.ts.
3. VoiceInterview.tsx: keep `priorSessionRef` (id, token, status, turns) at finalize so the previous session survives start()'s reset. Add an autoUsed counter per page, reset on a completed ending. Add the plan effect and the startPrecondition gate in start().
4. ReconnectNotice.tsx plus 4-locale copy. Change errConnectionLost to stop promising a button. The notice now says what is happening.
5. Doc: add the drop, save-first and redial sequence and the 2-redial budget to docs/features/interviews/README.md.

## Expected impact
A mid-interview network blip on the candidate portal goes from 'find Start, maybe get told you are in another window, come back in 30 minutes' to an automatic continuation within about 5 seconds of the network returning. The candidate stays on the page, the earlier answers are preserved, and the interviewer resumes where it left off. It also closes the self-inflicted INTERVIEW_ALREADY_LIVE lockout for manual retries. Spend stays bounded: 2 automatic /connect calls, both of which a manual retry would have made anyway.

## Evaluation
Claim: a dropped directed call is saved and then redialled without the candidate's click, cancellably and within budget, and no Start ever dials over its own unsaved session.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (reconnect-plan.ts does not exist, and saveStateOf is absent).
After: 7 of 7.
Method: node:test over app/_components/voice/reconnect-plan.test.ts (pure plan plus the saveStateOf helper) under npm run test:unit. i18n:check, design:check, lint and tsc run on the combined tree. No perf-budget exposure: the voice shell is reached only through dynamic imports (VoiceInterviewClient; app/features/shell/WorkspaceTabChunks.tsx:47), never app/page.tsx's static graph.
Result: pending build.
Gate: contract.
